name: Jiangsu Broadcasting Cable Information Network Corporation Limited
summary: Headquartered in Nanjing, China, Jiangsu Broadcasting Cable Information Network Corporation Limited manages and operates extensive radio and television infrastructures across the country. The company's activities include transmitting radio and television signals, developing and overseeing enhanced digital television services, and providing high-speed data broadband access. It previously operated as a subsidiary of Jiangsu Guojin Group Information Network Investment Co., Ltd.
